title: ScholarQuest: A Taxonomy-Guided Benchmark for Agentic Academic Paper Search in Open Literature Environments
abstract: arXiv:2606.20235v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Academic paper search is a core step in scientific research, and LLM-based search agents are emerging as a promising paradigm for iterative, intent-driven literature exploration. However, existing benchmarks offer limited coverage of research intents and insufficient support for scalable answer construction and reproducible multi-turn evaluation. We propose \textbf{ScholarQuest}, a taxonomy-guided benchmark constructed from over 1,000 computer science topics and organized around four research intents. To construct answer sets at scale, we combine multi-source retrieval, citation expansion, and multi-stage relevance adjudication. We further build \textit{\textbf{ScholarBase}}, a million-scale literature environment with unified retrieval and citation-expansion interfaces, together with a shared multi-turn search harness. translated_title: ScholarQuest：一个面向开放文献环境中智能体式学术论文搜索的分类法引导基准
translated_abstract: 学术论文搜索是科学研究中的核心步骤，基于大语言模型（LLM）的搜索智能体正成为迭代式、意图驱动的文献探索的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有基准对研究意图的覆盖有限，并且在可扩展的答案构建和可复现的多轮评估方面支持不足。我们提出了ScholarQuest，一个由超过1000个计算机科学主题构建、围绕四种研究意图组织的分类法引导基准。为大规模构建答案集，我们结合了多源检索、引用扩展和多阶段相关性裁定。我们进一步构建了ScholarBase，一个具有统一检索和引用扩展接口的百万级规模文献环境，并配备了共享的多轮搜索测试框架。我们在此框架中对完整的文献搜索系统进行基准测试，并比较其中所用的语言模型，评估……
tldr: 该论文提出了ScholarQuest——一个基于1000多个计算机科学主题、围绕四种研究意图构建的智能体学术论文搜索基准，并配套百万级文献环境ScholarBase，实现了可扩展的答案构建与可复现的多轮搜索评估。
en_tdlr: ScholarQuest is a taxonomy-guided benchmark for LLM-based agentic paper search, built from over 1,000 computer science topics across four research intents, paired with ScholarBase, a million-scale literature environment that enables scalable answer construction and reproducible multi-turn evaluation.
